name: Server fleet: AFR and availability
purpose: Exercises the annualized failure rate and the MTTR-driven availability. Also pins the divergence between the two AFR definitions: at a 2920 h MTBF, 95% of units fail within a year while a repaired unit averages 3 failures over the same span.

expected.note: Availability holds for any life distribution: long-run uptime of an alternating renewal process depends only on the means.
